title: Channel strategy scratch + AWS/GCP partner 1:1 prep
content:
Purpose:
Quick prep notes for upcoming 1:1s with AWS Marketplace partner manager + weekly GCP channel sync. This is a scratchpad — capture talking points, asks, open blockers, and follow up drafts. Keep light; will copy relevant pieces into a tidy mail after the calls.

Objectives for calls:
- Confirm listing timeline (AWS) and technical review checklist (GCP).
- Clarify procurement & contract flow: how enterprise customers will buy Redwood Dedicated vs hosted via marketplace consumption.
- Align on marketing ops / co-sell hygiene (TAC, lead routing, SKUs).
- Surface telemetry we can share to demonstrate latency & cost benefits for reference customers (need metrics).

Agenda (high level):
1) Quick intros & goals (3 min)
2) Status update from Redwood (what's ready now) (5 min)
3) Partner asks / gating items (10–12 min)
   - Listing asset checklist (legal + technical + logos)
   - Procurement and billing workflow (metered vs committed)
   - Support model for marketplace-bought Dedicated instances
4) Ops & go-to-market alignment (10 min)
   - Joint Webinars? Solution briefs? Case study cadence
5) Next steps and owners (5 min)

Talking points (Redwood):
- Quick rephrase of Redwood value prop for partner PM (30s): "Developer-first inference platform with hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — we make inference predictable and cost-efficient across cloud and on-prem workloads."
- What we have ready: model catalog + verified perf profiles, basic marketplace listing assets (short description, logo variants, high-level pricing SKU), onboarding playbook draft.
- What we need from partner: expected review SLAs, any partner-only security questionnaire templates, product-specific listing taxonomy for AWS/GCP.
- Commercial ask: can marketplace listing support both consumption/metered pricing for Hosted API and reserved SKU for Dedicated? If not, what's recommended workaround (subscribe + seat license + external billing)?

Technical checklist (things to confirm during technical review):
- Packaging: do we need an AMI for Dedicated listing or is a simple web listing with private deployment instructions OK?
- Network: recommended VPC peering model for private deployments vs customer-managed VPN. Who owns routing docs?
- IAM: minimum required roles we must declare for installer; example policy snippets to provide.
- Compat matrix: supported regions, minimum GPU families, private deployment requirements (KMS, HSM hints).
- AV & certs: any mandatory certs or scanning requirements for marketplace listings?

Open blockers (notes to resolve before listing):
- Legal: Redwood EULA flagged by AWS legal for marketplace template (see linked Confluence). Need legal to OK clause X by EOD 2026-03-05.
- Pricing model: internal debate on whether to expose a per-token meter in marketplace; Product says no for now because metering + refunds edgecases. Need partner ops to confirm recommended pattern.
- Support SLA: marketplace expects a defined escalation path for customers who buy through marketplace—need SRE sign-off on on-call rotation and runbook.

Data & telemetry we can share (prep list):
- Token latency 95/99 pct numbers for hosted vs dedicated (region breakdown).
- Cost-per-1k-tokens estimates by model family (gpt-style vs open encoder) — approximate numbers only, mark as draft.
- Sample logs/observability screenshots (Console dashboards) to include in listing page — confirm PII redaction.

Immediate asks / asks to raise in the call:
- AWS: Can we get a direct contact for the marketplace technical review team so we can schedule an onboarding scoping call? (ask for calendar owner)
- GCP: Clarify billing reconciliation window for partner resellers (30/45/60 days?).
- Both: Any public guide for co-marketing approvals and length of review cycle for joint content?

Role-specific notes (quick):
- Ask Legal (Priya): approve marketplace EULA mods; flag regulator-sensitive verbiage for EU customers.
- Ask SRE (Ethan): confirm support on-call triage for first 60 days after listing; prepare runbook stub.
- Ask Product (me): finalize pricing SKUs for Dedicated vs Hosted to present.

Draft follow-up email (post-call):
Subject: Next steps from today’s AWS/GCP marketplace sync\nHi [PartnerName],
Thanks for the time today — appreciated the clarity on the technical review path. Per our discussion:
- Redwood will submit listing assets by [date].
- Partner to provide technical-review contact and expected SLA for listing review.
- Action owner assignments below.
Action items:
- Nadia: submit full listing draft + sample telemetry screenshots by 2026-03-10
- Priya (Legal): finalize EULA changes by 2026-03-05
- Ethan (SRE): deliver support runbook + contact on-call schedule by 2026-03-12
- Partner: share technical reviewer contact and co-marketing approval cadence by 2026-03-08
I’ll follow up with a Confluence link that collects assets and open items.
Best,
Nadia

Action tracker (scratch):
- [ ] Submit listing draft (owner: Nadia) — due 2026-03-10
- [ ] Legal EULA approvals (owner: Priya) — due 2026-03-05
- [ ] Support runbook (owner: Ethan) — due 2026-03-12
- [ ] Confirm marketplace SKU mapping (owner: Product Ops) — due 2026-03-14
- [ ] Arrange technical onboarding call with AWS review team (owner: Partner PM) — due 2026-03-08

Metrics for 90-day success (proposal):
- 5 inbound leads routed via marketplace (net new)
- 2 paid trials converted to committed Reserved/Dedicated purchases
- <100ms median token latency delta vs baseline for Dedicated customers in target regions

Notes to self (loose):
- Keep the first listing simple: hosted + reserved SKU for Dedicated; avoid metered tokens until we have robust refunds / billing mappings.
- Consider a separate partner-friendly installer doc for private deployments (concise checklist + automated preflight).
- Capture examples of customers who benefited from switching to Dedicated (ops cost reduction story).

Unresolved questions to log in Confluence under CP-4021:
- Can AWS support hybrid purchase flows (marketplace purchase initiating a manual contract for Dedicated)?
- Are there region-specific restrictions for GCP marketplace listings for GPU SKUs?

End of scratchpad.

---
Small personal note: don’t forget to ping Samir about co-marketing creative budget before we commit webinar dates.
plain_text_summary: Scratchpad: Nadia Patel's prep for AWS & GCP partner 1:1s. Contains agenda, objectives, technical checklist, open blockers, action items with owners and due dates, draft follow-up email, 90-day success metrics, and notes to self. Collaborators: Ethan Kim, Priya Shah.
